method.coordinates: Exact cubic Glyphs master, not quadratics/raster. Segment indices are zero-based RecordingPen command indices, include moveTo/closePath.
method.curvature: signed det(Bprime,Bdoubleprime)/norm(Bprime)^3; units inverse font-unit. Radius = abs(1/k), null for line/zero curvature.
method.normal_width: At selected outer cubic t, intersect ray in the left tangent-normal direction with every other source segment by solving cubic line-crossing polynomials; nearest positive hit. Numeric root tolerance1e-7 imaginary/1e-8 parameter; near own join hits below1e-5 rejected.
method.t_parameter_warning: t is Bezier parameter, not normalized arclength; samples establish behavior at listed stations, not extrema.
method.cap_depth: Sample 10001t/segment, projection from chord midpoint normal to start-end cap chord; approximate maximum, source coordinates exact.
method.reuses: Exact equality of all four cubic control vectors after translation; no optical near-match threshold.
method.limits: No claim these sampled glyphs prove universal designer intent. Ray width is local stroke thickness at that contour station; complex intersections may hit another branch and are recorded for inspection.

upper_cap.note: Depth sampling matches native_caps. This comparison describes cap geometry, not a claim that all native caps share one shape.
